title: [GMCP 203.006.02] Production path: Production-grade Streamable HTTP transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-006-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes current Streamable HTTP over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with correct POST semantics, media negotiation, streaming and non-streaming responses, origin/host validation, protocol and method headers, cache controls, cancellation, backpressure, connection limits, TLS, proxy awareness, and graceful drain. Removed GET/SSE-resume/session behavior is rejected on the modern path and confined to explicit legacy adapters. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
